fact: The Payment Systems Act (No. 15 of 2016) commenced on 30 June 2017 and requires a Reserve Bank licence or authorization to operate payment systems, remittance, electronic money transfer or mobile payment services, naming mobile payment operators and non-bank financial institutions as possible licensees.
title: Payment Systems Act (Chapter 74:01)
